items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Freida Shaw and Band. Earl Thompson

ctx.x: out here with a band called Speed Webb, a band out of Ohio. It was a heck of a good band. It was a reading band. All of the guys... Also a trumpet player that played with Andy Kirk when we went on the boat, when I left here on went on a boat -- Earl Thompson was his name; terrific trumpet player.
How long did you stay with this Liberty Dance Orchestra?
